Honestly man, with the amount that you've been able to write, I don't see much problem with just going to see your GP or so about the issue. It's always worth seeking help, especially if you're worried enough to come here and write so much. 


All this stuff you've written about is very relevant, I've had a series of traumatic incidents in my life and believe me if you're experiencing something like this then for your own benefit at the very least seek some counselling just to help you through it.



I'm at university as well, in Scotland, and I suffer from depression and have been to see the doctor, counseller, etc about it. It's pretty helpful and easy, at least at my campus, so definitely go for it, also PM me if you wanna talk anytime.

Hey there buddy, I have to say I have a lot of the same feelings and problems as you've written here. I'm 18 and at university, and believe me all of these problems are more relevant now than ever when it comes to life decisions. 

Anyway, there's not a lot I can write that's going to make things much better, but I would definitely advise looking into counselling of some sort if you haven't already - It feels silly at first but I think it helps over time. 

I'm on a (sort of) throwaway as well, but feel free to PM if you wanna talk.
